title: Vivex biograft based on recovered metal regrows bone

tellings.quote: They were creating what's called a viograph which was uh it was based on metal the metal that they recovered

plain: In the 2010s, a medical material called a biograft, a substance placed in the body to help bone regrow, was made from metal recovered from a crashed craft. That is what Chris Bledsoe says. He is a man who says UFOs appear around him, and he tells it as something he was close to, naming a man called Timothy Taylor in connection with it. If true, material from a crash would have been turned into medicine.
